Instagram Video Editor App — Initial Release

- Instantly edit and export Instagram-ready videos by uploading clips and describing your desired result; optimized for quick 30–60 second cloud rendering.
- Handles smart editing, resizing, captions, and formatting for Instagram posts, Reels, and Stories, with no need for timeline editing or export settings.
- Automatic connection to backend cloud editor via user token or free anonymous authentication; session managed seamlessly in the background.
- Supports file uploads, downloads, credits/balance checking, and exports in multiple popular video and audio formats.
- Helpful error handling, progress updates during processing, and intelligent routing of user requests based on intent.
- Designed for fast, user-friendly Instagram content creation with minimal setup.
